reviewItem.question: Does "Storage version of `imagerepositories.image.toolkit.fluxcd.io` changes v1beta2 → v1" mean a change to migration:flux|name=imagerepository-storage-version-migration (migration-required)?

proposed.statement: The storage version of imagerepositories.image.toolkit.fluxcd.io changes from v1beta2 to v1, so existing ImageRepository objects stay stored as v1beta2 until an operator runs a storage version migration (re-writing all objects and updating status.storedVersions) before a later release removes v1beta2.
